bullets.text: Heavy rains lashed Chennai leaving Velachery AGS Colony under knee-deep water and residents stranded, requiring continuous monitoring and immediate relief operations by the office.
Two 14-year-old schoolboys drowned in Puzhal Lake near Murugambedu and their bodies were recovered, prompting the office to urge strict safety warnings around water bodies.
A fire in a Poonamallee hut destroyed livestock including cattle, goats, and poultry, and the office should ensure immediate relief reaches the affected family.
The government called tenders to clear Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham canals, and the office must track this project to mitigate flooding in Velachery.
One entrance to Puzhuthivakkam MRTS station remains closed months after inauguration forcing long detours, and the office should coordinate with railways to open it.
Rotary International honoured 113 teachers at Guru Nanak College in Velachery, and the office should acknowledge local educational excellence initiatives.
Inflow has increased into Puzhal and Poondi lakes due to heavy rains, and the district team must closely monitor water levels and reservoir safety.
Commuters at the Avadi temporary bus terminus face hardships due to poor civic amenities during construction, so the office must expedite infrastructure improvements.
Police traced a missing eight-year-old girl from Sriperumbudur to a children's home in Kellys, and the office should review child safety protocols in the district.
Chennai Mayor Priya condemned defamatory AI-generated videos of herself on social media without police action, and the portfolio team should monitor AI misuse regulations.
Power-ready land has become India's new data center currency as states compete for investments, and the portfolio team should streamline power allocations for data hubs.
Artificial intelligence is transforming flavor development with Chennai turning into a key hub, and the office should support local food-tech innovations.
Equinix India plans to expand its data center capacity aiming for 70 MW, and the office should facilitate necessary approvals to secure this investment.
